featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a proud member of Garad Foundation for the past Two year, and my experience has been truly inspiring. participation from volunteers, showing a strong commitment to saving lives.

One of the highlights has been their focus on education and youth empowerment. They have conducted free courses on career guidance and personality development, delivered by respected professionals from various fields. These sessions not only enlightened students but also opened doors for financial aid through government collaborations.

Garad Foundation is deeply committed to supporting the economically weaker sections of society. Students receive free books, and special drives like the one "MISSIONBHARARI" where we all contributed ₹150 to provide sandals to tribal children are examples of their thoughtful approach to grassroots impact.

During times of crisis, like the recent drought, the foundation extended help by distributing food supplies to those in need. It also promotes the Skill India initiative, regularly informing members about free courses and opportunities for upskilling.

📚 Mission Bharari – Phase 3
